Name: Super Hopper
Author: spacechase0
Description:
Upgrade hoppers to transfer items between two chests automatically (mainly for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url] users).


[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
[b][size=3]For players[/size][/b]
Left click a Hopper with an iridium bar, and it will change colors and start moving things from a chest immediately above it to one immediately below it. Left click with an empty hand to downgrade it and get your iridium bar back.

For example, you can use this to create automated supply chains. Note how Automate sees three separate machine groups, so the shipping bins in the third group can't steal milk from the chest in the first group:[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]


[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.
